values.summary: Initialize and review the source-grounded kernel-authority design, bind #450, replace resident duplicate derivation with one typed kernel adapter, add restart/divergence proof, retain behavior, then update evidence truth after production-path validation.

steps.action: Validate live issue scope, source census, authority design, and typed readiness.
Bind #450 and implement one typed resident adapter to the Runtime-kernel Memory Palace authority without duplicate writable truth.
Implement exact restart/rehydration state validation and fail-closed divergence, rollback, gap, duplicate, forgery, and schema handling.
Run focused kernel, adapter, actual-resident-path, restart, and negative proof; retain migration dispositions.
Update canonical feature/evidence truth only after exact production proof and complete exact-head review.

invariants: One writable Memory Palace topology and working-set authority
Identity and continuity are production inputs, never fabricated
Canonical and packet digests cover the authoritative content
Restart cannot accept rollback, gaps, duplicates, forgery, or incompatible schema
Agents without Memory Palace configuration retain existing no-artifact behavior
risks: The legacy adl crate does not currently depend on adl-runtime-kernel and integration may require a bounded dependency edge
Existing resident inputs may not expose every kernel authority field directly
Schema migration may affect retained fixtures and consumers
Production-path proof may reveal continuity-generation plumbing gaps
stop_conditions: Production identity or continuity would need to be fabricated
The proposed change creates a third Memory Palace representation or duplicate writable derivation
Required work expands into broad ObsMem or Runtime redesign
